scope.evidence: Cross-cutting changes across Twitch auth runtime, integration lifecycle, health/setup projection, worker gating, tests, and bilingual documentation.

integration.evidence: Twitch OAuth validation/refresh, Helix initialization, EventSub WebSocket, durable outbox workers, and process lifecycle interact.

infrastructure.evidence: No new service or schema expected; changes use existing process/Compose lifecycle.

knowledge.evidence: Requires verified Twitch OAuth failure semantics and exact behavior of installed Twurple 8.2.0 reconnect implementation.

risk.evidence: Incorrectly classifying auth can either lock out a valid streamer or continue using revoked scopes; financial state must remain safe.

rationale: The story affects the critical Twitch integration lifecycle and requires error classification, startup/restart recovery, EventSub/outbox coordination, and tests across failure boundaries. Use the full Spec Pipeline, two critique passes, and a sequenced implementation plan.
